wiki.title: Russel Tempel
wiki.extract: Russel E. Tempel (born 1947) is an American politician. He serves as a Republican member of the Montana Senate, where he represents District 14, including Chester, Montana. Tempel was a part of a moderate coalition of nine Republicans formed with Democrats in the 69th Montana Legislature, dubbed the "nasty nine" by opponents and was censured on March 27 for his efforts.
